description: Single full-body native pixel-art game sprite. IDENTITY MUST MATCH: Slim youthful man with soft oval face, small chin, gentle modest closed-mouth smile, NOT rugged. Neat rounded dark brown-black BOWL haircut with SHORT straight fringe well ABOVE eyebrows, visible forehead strip. Large black aviator sunglasses. Narrow natural shoulders and slender arms. Dark brown-charcoal single-breasted suit neatly buttoned, white shirt and tidy black necktie. No scars, beard or muscular bulk. Black trousers and plain black formal shoes. Relaxed upright stance with empty hands at sides. Front-facing SOUTH, low top-down camera. Natural adult anatomy, about 7 heads tall, normal torso and pelvis. Anatomical crown-to-sole height 214-222 pixels on a 128x256 canvas; hair may extend above crown. Soles at y248; leave unused space ABOVE shorter people, do NOT enlarge to fill frame. Keep individual build and facial features. Match reference ONLY for crisp 1px pixel clusters, selective dark outlines and controlled shading. Keep own hair and costume colors. Transparent background, no ground shadow, no text, no held weapons. Whole hair and shoes within frame.

style_image.usage_description: Use ONLY pixel rendering, outline, shading and lighting. Do not copy the reference male height, body shape, shoulder width, outfit or identity. Preserve this character own stature, build, age, hair, irises and original clothing colors and silhouette. FRONT view.
